Can’t find a better app. That’s both a good and bad thing. This app does what only it can do and it does it extremely well. But it also promises to perform in certain ways and it does so very terribly.

The prompt feature sometimes feels like a prank. The app pretty much does whatever it wants despite what you tell it. Especially when converting an image to video. Saying things like “She puts her hands in her pockets. The camera is stationary with no movement or zooming. Keep her full body in the frame.” I will receive results with an instant zoom into her face.

This is the best AI generator for characters and scenes that are realistic and dynamic. But, the more detailed you get the less of the details you get.

Also, if I say “Black woman wearing a blue dress”, there’s a high probability, she’ll be in a black dress. And so I usually have to say “African American woman” which takes up more characters where characters are tightly limited.

Also, if I don’t say “African American”, the character’s coming out white, despite whether or not my reference image is a Black person.

And also, the incessant cropped tops and excessive cleavage results…honestly. I say “collared shirt” and my girl comes back with all her buttons undone. For Pete’s sake! 
I say “t-shirt” and she’s in a crop top so tight and short, I bet her circulation would cut off if she were real!
And it doesn’t matter what different ways I try to say it, those results are constant until I get that ONE image where she’s just in a regular shirt.
Ask for an image describing the character’s full outfit down to the shoes and the image is cropped off at the knees.
Ask for a ponytail and the hair is down.
Ask for a knee-length skirt and I get a mini-skirt with a split.

And the app doesn’t respond to negatives even if you try to reword it as a positive.

Straight up? This app is what the old folks would call “hard of hearing.”

Body types are so difficult. If she’s of average build or fit and also endowed, but you’re just wanting a fully dressed, realistic woman, it’s a fine line, let me tell you. There are few words you can say to get a woman who isn’t plus sized but has something over a C cup and a healthy trunk. You’re either getting Lizzo or Taylor Swift. I’ve found ONE phrase that gets me in the range I need but it leaves little room for nuance.

But what keeps me coming back? Unlimited generations. So, even though the results I get are often majorly majorly wrong, I just keep hitting generate until it suddenly gets it absolutely right. It’s a bear in time consumption, but I’m stubborn and the results in my work is worth it. Though if I could find a better option that reduced time and stress, I’d run over there, cuz…phew!

I’ve honestly gotten some fashion ideas from the images it’s given me. And SOMETIMES, when it gets the outfit wrong, the app has inspired me to redesign my character’s look. So I don’t completely hate the different results, I just wish there was a balance. I wish it gave me more of what I’m actually asking for more often than not.

I wish there was a way to tell the app “no that result was bad”, “yes! That’s perfect! Give me more of this!” Or even “give me this again in a different pose”. There’s no teaching it or guiding it, just banging your head against the wall until you get the result you want.

The UI is clean and easy to navigate. One of the easiest honestly. And I do love how consistently the app improves and develops its features. Wish it would improve all that stuff I mentioned above though.

*I deal exclusively with the image and video generators for realistic custom images. I don’t have experience with any of the other features or editing of existing images. So I can’t speak on them.

*Do I recommend it, yes. Absolutely. But come prepared with the proper expectations.
